description: OVERWRITE a project's launch.json with the text given. The whole file is replaced, so read it with read_launch_config first and send the full text back, or comments and configurations you did not mean to touch are lost. Invalid JSONC is refused before anything is written. Returns the path written and any pre-flight issues in the result.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the daemon's current project.

file.description: Which convention to create for a project that has neither. A project that already has a launch.json is written back to that same file.

text.description: The complete file contents. JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed.

name: write_launch_config
